# Capture checklist: Stays

<!-- Generated by `node core/bin/capture.ts build` from data/vocab/types.json and core/src/schema/capture/properties.ts. Do not edit by hand. -->

R is required for Usable, R? is required when its condition holds, A is applicable (counts for Complete). Properties not listed are never asked. Suitability paths are listed under their profile; the full list for a type is `node core/bin/capture.ts fields --type <id>`.

## Rooms (`stay.room`)

Records: place, offer. Suitability profile `stay` (never). Effort: none, time is shown. Sources, in order: O F.

**place**: R name, type, point, area_id, summary, season, hours, access_cost, price, links; R? none; A names, osm_ref, geonames_id, access_points, transit, window, pairs_with, photos, part_of.

**offer (lodging)**: R name, type, summary, access_cost, price, links, at, check_in_out, cost_band; R? none; A names, transit, window, pairs_with, photos, part_of, on, run_by, cancellation.

Suitability: R wheelchair; R when operated none; A min_age, kid_note, stroller, stroller_extent, access_detail, accessible_toilet, accessible_parking, baby_change, access_season.

Links: official; R? none; A booking, terms, accessibility.
